directions: Lightly butter the bottom and sides of a 9x9x2-inch pan.
Melt butter in a heavy 3-quart saucepan. Add sugar and salt and stir.
Stir in corn syrup. Gradually pour in sweetened condensed milk, stirring constantly.
Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, to 245°F on a candy thermometer.
Remove from heat and stir in vanilla.
Immediately pour into prepared pan. Cool on a wire rack.
When fully cooled, cut into squares. Dip knife in water between cuts if needed.
Wrap each caramel in plastic wrap and store in an airtight container in a cool, dry place.
